hashes.bundle_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON containing the frozen gate schema version and private shadow/historical file SHA-256 values; the public manifest itself is excluded.
hashes.case_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON before canonical_sha256 insertion

algorithm.changed_token_minhash: Form every consecutive 5-token shingle; encode each shingle as a compact UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false; SHA-256 each distinct encoding; retain the lexicographically smallest 8 hashes, or all hashes when fewer than 8.
algorithm.deduplication: Deduplicate by underlying canonical repository and source commit within each set. Preserve separate shadow and historical entries when a commit belongs to both sets; omit target signatures only from shadow entries.
algorithm.patch_normalization: Parse unified-diff hunks; retain only lines beginning + or - inside a @@ hunk; remove the one-character change prefix; strip leading/trailing whitespace; collapse each Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space; Unicode-lowercase each line; join lines in patch order with LF; hash UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256.
algorithm.target_normalization: Strip leading/trailing whitespace from the complete target; collapse each Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space; Unicode-lowercase; hash UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256.
algorithm.target_token_minhash: Form every consecutive 3-token shingle; encode each shingle as a compact UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false; SHA-256 each distinct encoding; retain the lexicographically smallest 8 hashes, or all hashes when fewer than 8.
algorithm.tokenization: Apply Python regex [A-Za-z0-9_]+|[^\s] to normalized text in order.
